newsitem.title: USA: Teleport off amid uncertainty on offering.
newsitem.headline: Teleport off amid uncertainty on offering.

text.p: Shares of Teleport Communications Group Inc weakened on Wednesday after the company said it was considering an offering of common stock and debt securities in the second quarter.
Teleport, a competitive local exchange carrier, lost 2-3/8 to 24-1/2 in midafternoon trading.

One analyst, who declined to be named, said there was some investor uncertainty after the announcement, made on Monday, because Teleport had not yet determined the amount of securities involved in the possible offering.
Teleport said adverse changes in market conditions could cause it to delay or abandon its plans for an offering.
